task_name: Continental Cup - Squad press and partner kit
client_brief:
Expand our licensed player-card production to the full stocked squad

The licensing partner has taken the full Continental Cup squad. We now need the eighteen-player material reconciled against the stock roster and produced from last season's printer PDF.

Scope
1. Squad player press sheet: 19 named exports. The portrait belongs to the named player. The squad facts match the register.
2. Player partner graphic: 18 named exports. The player number is clear. The competition identity is visible.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.tagline: The whole squad, under the lights.
brand_identity.sector: Officially licensed collectible trading cards for a touring North American and European club football tournament, sold into grocery, newsstand and hobby channels through a national licensing partner.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: touring competition, Western Europe and North America; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
brand_identity.about: Continental Cup 2026 is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is touring competition, Western Europe and North America, and this commission covers phase 2: squad press run and partner files.
brand_identity.audience: Collectors aged sixteen to forty five who buy officially licensed sets beside other marquee cards, in grocery aisles, at newsstands and in hobby shops. They notice when a card in the pack looks like it came from somewhere else.
brand_identity.price_positioning: A flagship licensed pack retailing around fourteen dollars, positioned above community and league sets and below fine-art prints. It must read as a marquee cup collectible, saturated and cinematic, never as a cheap programme or a gallery piece.
brand_identity.typography: Surnames and squad numbers set in Bungee Regular 400 all caps, a signage face. The first thing seen in the pack is the number: every squad number is Bungee Regular in Pitch Black with Bungee Inline 400 registered exactly on top in Floodlight Gold, so each figure carries a gold core stripe. Press sheets run the surname 40 pt and the number 96 pt; partner graphics 84 px and 220 px. Position, club and set year take Trade Gothic LT Condensed No. 18 Regular at 12 pt in print and 28 px on screen. Never print a number without its Inline layer.
brand_identity.voice: Bold, terse, terrace-proud. Copy is short and declarative. Example line the brand would write: 'Eighteen players. One set. Every card earns its place in the sleeve.'
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: There is no surviving design file or logo artwork. The tournament mark now exists only on printed things: the sole reference is a handheld photograph of a pitch-side sponsor board carrying the mark in one deep ink on a pale board. It has to be recovered as usable artwork before it can be placed at any size.
brand_identity.values: A licensed set is a promise: every player is who the card says, and the look holds across the whole squad rather than favouring a hero. Consistency in the sleeve is the product.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: Every squad number is Bungee Regular in Pitch Black with Bungee Inline locked exactly on top in Floodlight Gold, so each figure carries a gold core stripe down its centre.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Reconcile records before merge and prove page, row, name, and amount completeness from the delivered artifacts.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
